summary.text: Ronald Kokinda is the Republican candidate for the Michigan House of Representatives, District 2, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces Democrat Joanna Whaley.
A small business owner and business consultant, he won the August 4, 2026 Republican primary and ran for the same seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Ronald Kokinda was born in Troy, New York, and earned a bachelor's degree from the State University of New York at Stony Brook in 1971.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as small business owner and business consultant, and notes that he has been affiliated with the LaRouche Political Action Committee.
In 2024, Kokinda was the Republican nominee for Michigan House District 2; incumbent Democrat Tullio Liberati won with 51.8% of the vote to Kokinda's 42.4%.
In 2026 he defeated Zacharia Ortiz in the Republican primary, 74.4% to 25.6%.
